THIS LEASE is made between Riverside Holdings (the Landlord) and Acme Ltd (the Tenant).
1. The term of this lease is three (3) years beginning on 1 March 2026.
2. The Tenant shall pay rent of USD 2,500 per calendar month, each instalment
to be paid in advance on the first day of the month.
3. For the purposes of IFRS 16 the Tenant's incremental borrowing rate is 8.5% per annum.
4. Late payments accrue interest at 18% per annum.
